mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.name, CASE WHEN p.source_label = '分行中台' THEN '分行关注' ELSE p.source_label END AS source, p.sap_id AS owner_id, p.creator_name AS owner_name, u.pst_lvl AS owner_level, p.period_start, p.period_end FROM swe_wealth_plans p LEFT JOIN rm_jkh_user_info u ON p.sap_id COLLATE utf8mb4_bin = u.user_id WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.source_label IN ('我的关注', '分行中台', '行长关注') AND p.id IN #{id}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM rm_jkh_user_info WHERE first_bbk_id = #{bbkId} AND org_id = #{orgId}

SELECT DISTINCT s.plan_id, j.tenant_id AS sap_id, s.scene_id AS skill_id, k.skill_name, j.id AS job_id FROM swe_wealth_plan_scenes s JOIN swe_marketplace_skills k ON k.skill_id = s.scene_id AND k.source_id = 'RMASSIST' JOIN swe_cron_jobs j ON j.plan_id = s.plan_id AND j.skill_ids = s.scene_id AND j.source_id = 'RMASSIST' AND j.status != 'deleted' WHERE s.deleted = 0 AND
(s.plan_id = #{r.planId} AND j.tenant_id = #{r.sapId})

SELECT DISTINCT e.job_id, e.trace_id, e.actual_time, e.is_read AS `read` FROM swe_cron_executions e JOIN swe_plan_sence_cron c ON e.actual_time >= CAST(c.execute_day AS DATE) AND e.actual_time < DATE_ADD(CAST(c.execute_day AS DATE), INTERVAL 1 DAY) WHERE c.execute_day >= #{query.startDate} AND c.execute_day <= #{query.endDate} AND
(e.job_id = #{r.jobId} AND c.plan_id = #{r.planId} AND c.sence_id = #{r.skillId} AND e.actual_time >= #{r.createdAt})

SELECT DISTINCT job_id, skill_id, trace_id, custuid AS customer_id FROM swe_cron_result_index WHERE result_type = 'plan' AND is_latest_success = 1 AND status = 'SUC' AND
(job_id = #{r.relation.jobId} AND skill_id = #{r.relation.skillId} AND trace_id = #{r.traceId})

SELECT DISTINCT d.cust_uid AS customer_id FROM swe_html_preview_click_events c JOIN swe_skill_contact_detail d ON d.click_id = c.id WHERE (c.event_type = 'button_click' OR (c.event_type = 'preview_view' AND c.template_type = 'sub')) AND d.cust_uid IS NOT NULL AND
(c.trace_id = #{r.execution.traceId} AND c.customer_id = #{r.customerId} AND c.clicked_at >= #{r.execution.executionDay} AND c.clicked_at < DATE_ADD(#{r.execution.executionDay}, INTERVAL 1 DAY))

SELECT DISTINCT c.trace_id, c.customer_id, DATE(c.clicked_at) AS execution_day, CASE WHEN c.event_type = 'button_click' THEN c.button_type ELSE NULL END AS button_type, d.cust_uid AS contact_customer_id FROM swe_html_preview_click_events c LEFT JOIN swe_skill_contact_detail d ON d.click_id = c.id WHERE (c.event_type = 'button_click' OR (c.event_type = 'preview_view' AND c.template_type = 'sub')) AND
(c.trace_id = #{r.execution.traceId} AND c.customer_id = #{r.customerId} AND c.clicked_at >= #{r.execution.executionDay} AND c.clicked_at < DATE_ADD(#{r.execution.executionDay}, INTERVAL 1 DAY))
